Name: HallowsEvePack
Description: Hallow's Eve, a yearly autumn event for any server running Ziggfreed's CommonLib and RPG Stations. Each October, Old Jack opens the Forgotten Temple with a questline, dailies and a nightly board, all paid in Hallow Sweets, and the dead walk at night. Throw Lantern Bombs, and trick-or-treat at every character with a conversation. RPG Stations runs the Carving Bench; MMO Skill Tree is optional and adds skill XP and set bonuses.
